name: wt-secret-guard
description: Function-hook secret scrubber for prompts, assistant text, tool results, and raw outbound tool inputs

ownerChannelRedaction.title: Redact Atrium message bodies instead of refusing them
ownerChannelRedaction.description: Only the text field of the supported Atrium speak adapters is rewritten; routing fields stay unchanged or the call is refused. Disable to retain refusal for all raw MCP inputs.

opAccount.title: 1Password account passed to `op read --account` (empty = the CLI's default account)
opAccount.description: Account passed as `op read --account <value>` when references are rewritten; leave empty on a single-account machine. OP_ACCOUNT does not reach op.exe through WSL interop.

opBinary.title: 1Password CLI executable the hook runs for `op read` (e.g. `op.exe` under WSL interop)
opBinary.description: The hook's own process capability spawns this executable; shell aliases do not apply there. Default `op`; under WSL, set `op.exe` when the Windows 1Password CLI is the signed-in one.

maskIpAddresses.title: Mask IP addresses in prompts and tool results
maskIpAddresses.description: Replace IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with stable redaction tokens before submitted prompts and tool results reach the model. This option cannot affect first-message context blocks.

maskEmails.title: Mask email addresses in prompts and tool results
maskEmails.description: Replace email addresses with stable redaction tokens before submitted prompts and tool results reach the model. This option cannot affect first-message context blocks.

secretFileReadWarnings.title: Warn when a tool would read a likely secret file
secretFileReadWarnings.description: Measurement-only warning. The read still executes and a value-free event is journaled.
